Issued by: Office of the Registrar, Northgate University
Subject: Mid-term examination
Date: 1 Jan
To all students.
The mid-term examination is scheduled on 1 Jan for all students.
For queries contact the office during working hours.
This matches the official schedule and remains unchanged.
According to this notice, the mid-term examination is on 3 Nov, whereas the official notice states 15 Sep.
Notice: the mid-term examination for all students has been postponed and rescheduled to 22 Sep, moving away from the earlier 15 Sep date.
Correction: an erratum has been issued for the mid-term examination. The corrected venue is Hall B; all other details remain.
The deadline for the mid-term examination registration has been extended to 28 Oct, beyond the original 14 Oct cutoff.
This is to inform all students that the mid-term examination has been cancelled until further notice.
Kindly clarify the arrangement mentioned in the circular; the details appear unclear regarding venue and timing.
